articles.title: Welsh gymnast Cemlyn-Jones announces retirement
articles.description: It was a special night for Welsh gymnast Joe Cemlyn-Jones. Not only did his three-month old daughter Hallie watch him compete for the first time, but it turned out to be the last time also as Cemlyn-Jones announced his retirement. "Genuinely, before each routine I had to stop myself from tearing up a bit, because it wasn't just my little one in the crowd for the very first time, my own daughter," Cemlyn-Jones told BBC Sport Wales.

articles.title: Kelly makes it two wins to start singles campaign
articles.description: Gary Kelly was in dominant form as he beat one of his closest rivals for a place in the semi-finals, Shannon McIlroy from New Zealand, 10-1, 7-5 to make it two wins to begin his challenge for gold in the men’s singles. The two-time Commonwealth medallist took charge of the game from the first bowl, keeping the New Zealander under constant pressure. McIlroy struggled to find consistency in his draws and even when he did produce a good bowl, Kelly, almost every time bettered him with his next effort.
